properties.name: Cozumel House for Sale
properties.description:
This is a one-of-a-kind home — you won't find another beautiful tropical home and garden like it on the island. Set in Colonia Independencia, this two-story Cozumel home sits seven blocks from the waterfront and just two blocks from the Sports Complex and Gardner School — a quiet, established neighborhood with easy reach to daily island life.

Behind 12-foot privacy walls, the 888 m² (9,558 ft²) lot is built around a pool framed by three palapas, a waterfall feature, and shaded sitting areas that make the garden the real heart of the property. Inside, 286.94 m² (3,089 ft²) of construction holds four bedrooms, three full bathrooms, and two separate living areas, with a layout designed for comfort — windows and ceiling fans throughout keep cross-breezes moving, and a laundry room, storeroom, gated entrance, and 2-car covered garage handle the practical side of island living.

The master bedroom is its own wing, with a palapa roof, a private patio over the garden, a skylight-lit bathroom with a view, a walk-in shower, and ample closet storage. Downstairs, a bedroom/office doubles as an accessible guest suite, with a wheelchair-accessible bathroom and a seated shower area.

One of Cozumel's more private properties, offered with a furnished option — a home away from home, or a permanent one.
